responsibility: Defines low-level access to the representation and arithmetic properties of REAL values, including compiler-known limits and format characteristics, mode flags, and operations for exponent/fraction decomposition, successor/predecessor, ulp, scaling, truncation, rounding, synthesis, and exception-state queries. It is the single-precision/normal-precision counterpart of LowLong for gm2 ISO floating-point introspection.
same_name_distinction: This is the definition/interface file for LowReal: it declares the corresponding low-level floating-point property and manipulation API for REAL values, distinguishing it from LowReal.mod, which implements those operations.
